title: Observe destination-owned intake decision without conflating receipt acceptance installation or execution authority
goal: Periodically observe a destination-owned intake decision record while preserving the distinctions among receipt, evaluation, acceptance, rejection, installation, and execution authority.
acceptance_criteria: absence or unreachable destination remains PENDING_DESTINATION_INTAKE_DECISION
destination acknowledgement is not treated as acceptance
observed decision matches required schema repository identities notification envelope and acknowledgement digests
evaluation acceptance and rejection states remain distinct
acceptance does not grant production installation or autonomous execution authority
rejection is preserved as a destination-owned decision rather than source-side failure
workflow records state changes and conditional successors automatically
